messages:
tara: heads-up: we need to coordinate a base-image rebuild next Wed for the minimal runtime cut (CVE backports + seccomp tighten). planning window 02:00-05:00 UTC.

maria: +1. will we change RBAC for the image deployer role in the same window? need to avoid a drift in keystore privileges.

aj: recommend we rotate the keystore envelopes before the cut. KMS team said rotation is fast but consumers need a grace pull.

kevin: oncall: please add an incident-runbook stub to the thread. if any staging nodes fail image pull we fallback to old tag. want automated rollback.

tara: good call. fallback plan = policy-bound image tags + routing rule in deployer: if image_pull_fail -> pin to :stable-old for 10m then alert.

maria: audit logging question: will the rebuild generate a spike in registry read events? do we have the log retention and ingest rate to capture full pull traces for the window?

aj: audit-log tailer looks OK but we should increase retention for 24h for the affected registry project. I can flip it via infra flag: registry.audit.retention=24h

maria: can you also add a filter to tag actions and keystore access so we can tie image signatures to KMS op IDs? that'll help for the post-cut forensic trail.

aj: will do. example filter: ```resource.type="container_registry" AND protoPayload.method="google.cloud.storage.objects.get" AND labels.image_signed=true```

kevin: vuln triage: we've got a small glibc patch backport; patch tested on staging. any runtime mitigations needed for attack surface besides seccomp?

tara: dropping some libc locales and removing non-essential binaries from /usr/bin. also set CAP_DROP list in container runtime.

maria: RBAC: we need to narrow the signer role used by CI: from signer.full -> signer.sign_create (no list/delete). will submit PR to iam repo.

aj: note: if we tighten the signer role, the staging attestation job needs an extra scope to read the signer key metadata. will add to PR.

maria: KMS integration: confirm HSM-backed signer key rotates on schedule. if rotation overlaps rebuild we should freeze rotation for 1 hour. can Platform Ops pause rotation?

deploy-bot: deployment window confirmed by CI: 2026-03-25T02:00Z -> 2026-03-25T05:00Z. Canary jobs set to 10% for 15m.

kevin: ops can pause key rotation, yes — I'll open a ticket and set pause: true on the rotation service for 1h before the window.

tara: checklist so far: 1) PR for signer RBAC (maria) 2) infra flag retention + audit filters (aj) 3) keystore envelope rotation pause (kevin) 4) secure-minimized base build (tara) 5) canary rules + rollback (deploy-bot) 6) post-cut forensic log runbook (maria)

maria: timeline: PRs by EOD Tue, infra changes staged Wed-4h before window, pause rotation 1h before. canary monitor alert thresholds: error_rate > 0.5% OR p50 latency +200ms -> rollback.

aj: I'll add a quick health-check that verifies cosign signature present and KMS op id attached. sample check: ```curl -s $REGISTRY/api/v1/images/$TAG/signature | jq .kmsOpId```

kevin: thanks — I'll be oncall for the window. if anything trips, ping @kevin and add incident-runbook tag on PagerDuty. :thumbsup:

tara: thanks team. i'll create the staging thread and link the runbook. ping here for any late blockers. :wave:
